# Bipartisan Policy Center

> The Bipartisan Policy Center advances practical, evidence-based policy solutions through cross-party collaboration on critical issues including democracy, elections, and civic engagement.

The Bipartisan Policy Center (BPC) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to finding common ground on divisive policy challenges. Their Business Alliance for Effective Democracy initiative mobilizes corporate leaders to strengthen democratic institutions and voting experiences through bipartisan collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Business Alliance for Effective Democracy
- Bipartisan Policy Center (BPC)
- Democracy Program
- Election Policy
- Civic Engagement
- Corporate Involvement
- Voting Experience
- Election Support
- Bipartisan Collaboration
- Congressional Relations

## Business Alliance & Democracy

- [Business Alliance for Effective Democracy](https://businessalliance.bipartisanpolicy.org/): Initiative promoting corporate civic engagement and business leadership in strengthening democratic institutions and voting experiences through bipartisan collaboration
